JThetaAttachment.originalBruhat_theta_radial_bound.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)] (f : MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K → ℂ)
  (hf : JThetaAttachment.IsOriginalBruhat K f) (U : Set (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K)) (hU : IsCompact U) (N : ℕ) :
  ∃ B,
    0 ≤ B ∧
      ∀ a ∈ U,
        ∀ (t : ℝ) (ht : 1 ≤ t),
          ‖Masullo.IdeleTheta.classTheta K f ↑(JThetaAttachment.thetaRadialIdele K t ⋯ * a)‖ ≤ B * (t ^ N)⁻¹
'JThetaAttachment.originalBruhat_theta_radial_bound' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
JThetaAttachment.originalTestDomain_iff_fourier_zero.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)] [BorelSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)]
  [LocallyCompactSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)] [SecondCountableTopology (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)]
  (addHaar : MeasureTheory.Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)) [addHaar.IsAddHaarMeasure]
  (mu : MeasureTheory.Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)) (a alpha s : ℝ)
  (psi : AddChar (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K) Circle) (f : MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K → ℂ) :
  f ∈ JThetaAttachment.originalTestDomain K addHaar mu a alpha s ↔
    JThetaAttachment.IsOriginalBruhat K f ∧
      f 0 = 0 ∧
        ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K), f x * ↑(psi (x * 0)) ∂addHaar = 0 ∧
          MeasureTheory.MemLp (JThetaAttachment.normalizedTheta K a alpha s f) 2 mu

CThetaLogDecay.originalBruhat_normalizedTheta_log_bound.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)] (a alpha s : ℝ) (f : MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K → ℂ)
  (hf : JThetaAttachment.IsOriginalBruhat K f) (U : Set (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K)) (hU : IsCompact U) (R : ℝ) :
  ∃ B,
    0 ≤ B ∧
      ∀ g ∈ U,
        ∀ (u : ℝ),
          0 ≤ u →
            ‖JThetaAttachment.normalizedTheta K a alpha s f ↑(JThetaAttachment.thetaLogSection K u * g)‖ ≤
              B * Masullo.GenuineMellinJet.nativeHalfWeight alpha s (u + Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K ↑g) *
                Real.exp (a * (u + Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K ↑g) - R * u)

  (hf : JThetaAttachment.IsOriginalBruhat K f) (U : Set (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K)) (hU : IsCompact U)
  (hU0 : ∀ g ∈ U, Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K ↑g = 0) :
  ∃ B,
    0 ≤ B ∧
      ∀ g ∈ U,
        ∀ (u : ℝ),
          0 ≤ u →
            ‖JThetaAttachment.normalizedTheta K a alpha s f ↑(JThetaAttachment.thetaLogSection K u * g)‖ ≤
              B * Real.exp (-rate * u)
